purpose: Categories and field schema for concall / earnings-call management extract

sentiment_rules.bullish: confident raise/strong guidance, robust demand, margin expansion clearly stated
sentiment_rules.optimistic: constructive / on-track / improving without big caveats
sentiment_rules.neutral: mixed or factual update, no clear lean
sentiment_rules.cautious: soft demand, temporary issues, watchful, delays while still managing
sentiment_rules.bearish: cuts, misses, structural pressure, defensive tone
